summary_md: **goose ([@JiegangLi99856](https://x.com/JiegangLi99856/status/2116095637939011724))** pairs two papers: *Representing the Unseen* ([arXiv 2610.37437](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37437)), showing accurate RGB from a world model is not always the best 'imagination interface' versus depth, panorama or top-down geometry, and *Swarm Telepathy* ([arXiv 2610.15095](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15095)), where passing KV-cache between agents beats text summaries by about 40% accuracy and 4× speed; the poster muses that models may evolve their own communication protocols.
